title: Friend dying on the moon

tellings.quote: There was a conversation I had with someone who I trust who got very emotional and described a friend of his dying on the moon.

plain: A man is said to have watched, or known about, a friend of his dying on the Moon, which would mean people have been working there in secret. The Australian investigative journalist Ross Coulthart tells it from a conversation with an unnamed source he trusts, who he says "got very emotional" describing the friend's death.
